data.title: New movies out this week: Sept 17-23
data.description: 7 new titles that hit cimenas in Thailand this week.

data.title: ‘Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger’ definitely lives up to title
data.description: For most of the 15 years since their split in 2009, the narrative surrounding the legendary British rock band Oasis has been “they are great, but …”. Now, with their Oasis Live ’25 Tour and its subsequent documentary “Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger”, Noel and Liam Gallagher are back together to add another “great” after the “but” and reshape the band’s narrative.

data.title: Trespassers trample fragile moss on Chiang Mai peak
data.description: Doi Inthanon National Park, home to Thailand’s highest mountain, has stressed the importance of following park rules after a group of visitors trespassed on a restricted area to take pictures, damaging the sphagnum moss that forms a delicate green carpets on the high-altitude mountain bog.

data.title: PM orders quick deportation of errant foreigners
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, in his capacity as the interior minister, has ordered provincial governors and district chiefs to act quickly to deport foreigners who commit offences and take advantage of Thais.

data.title: EU defends Canada alliance plan after Trump threat
data.description: BRUSSELS - EU chief Ursula von der Leyen’s proposal to make Canada an “associate member” of the bloc is not aimed against the United States, the European Commission said Thursday after President Donald Trump threatened trade ties over the plan.

data.title: LISA shares Thai food and language with The Tonight Show audience
data.description: LISA introduced Jimmy Fallon to som tam and a soju, Thai beer and Sprite mix before teaching him the Thai phrase “mot kaeo” (“finish your drink”).

data.title: TCMA wins Trade Prestige Award at Excellent Level for Fourth Straight Year
data.description: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has received the Trade Prestige Award 2026 at theExcellentlevel from the Department of Business Development (DBD), Ministry of Commerce, for the fourth consecutive year, recognizing its continued efforts to strengthen the competitiveness of Thailand’s cement industry and support the country’s transition towards a low-carbon economy.

data.title: KIJSETTHI MOBILITY & KIM LONG Partner to Launch ICE-EV Bus Line-up in Thailand
data.description: Positions itself as a One-Stop commercial mobility solutions provider,supporting operators across vehicle selection, specification customisation,spare parts and after-sales service, while opening pathways for expansion across ASEAN

data.title: CP Group Announces “CP Innovation Exposition 2026”, a National Innovation Showcase, Reimagined as “Future Fest”
data.description: Explore innovations from CP Group worldwide and its partners, meet the innovators, ask gurus directly, and discover new ideas through three days of interactive experiences, while HealthyLicious opens new opportunities for external innovators to scale future food businesses.

data.title: Asian Games chief defends ‘functional’ rooms after backlash
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - Accommodation for Asian Games athletes in Japan is “functional” and efforts are being made to deal with numerous complaints from disgruntled teams, a chief organiser told AFP.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ferrari Fairtex finds belief in small gloves after surviving Julio Lobo scare
data.description: Ferrari Fairtex is beginning to find something in ONE Championship’s small gloves that his talent alone could not guarantee: a way through the bad moments.

data.title: Love-struck woman learns ‘pilot’ boyfriend was AI creation
data.description: A 66-year-old woman from Lampang travelled to Chiang Mai in search of what she believed was true love with a pilot she had met online, only to discover he was an AI-generated character, police said on Thursday.

data.title: Leader’s sister says only ‘idiots’ think North Korea will give up nukes
data.description: SEOUL - The powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un said Thursday that the country’s nuclear-armed status was “absolute”, calling those hoping for its denuclearisation “idiots”.

data.title: Bangkok oil leak confirmed from Bangchak pipeline
data.description: Oil-contaminated wastewater in Bangkok has been traced to a Bangchak Group fuel pipeline along Chuea Phloeng Road in Khlong Toey district, Thitipat Chotidechachainan, secretary to the energy minister, confirmed on Thursday.

data.title: Scammers ‘rented Bangkok mansion for B900,000 a month’
data.description: Immigration police have arrested a group of foreigners who rented a mansion in Bangkok for 900,000 baht a month to operate a call scam centre targeting Japanese victims.

data.title: Croc-habitat river approved for 2032 Olympic rowing
data.description: SYDNEY - A river home to crocodiles was approved Thursday as the 2032 Brisbane Olympics rowing and canoeing venue by the sport’s governing bodies after a “thorough and robust assessment”.

data.title: NASA discovers new, ’once in a century’ Moon crater
data.description: WASHINGTON - A researcher at NASA has found a massive, recently-formed crater on the Moon, a rare occurrence that only happens “once in a century or even longer”, according to scientists.

data.title: Australia to cut migration to fix housing crisis
data.description: SYDNEY - Australia will reduce migration by curbing "visa hopping", tightening rules on students and working holiday makers as well as cracking down on overstayers, its interior minister said Thursday, as the far-right surges in the polls.

data.title: Global river flows lowest in decades, UN says
data.description: GENEVA - Rivers worldwide experienced one of their driest years in decades in 2025, according to the ​World Meteorological ⁠Organization, reflecting declining water storage across the Earth’s surface and raising concerns about future supplies.

data.title: 2,200 firms suspected of nominee land holding
data.description: Thai authorities have identified about 2,200 companies suspected of illegally holding land through foreign-majority ownership as part of a crackdown on nominee businesses.

data.title: Cash-for-photos scheme turns Indonesian poachers into protectors
data.description: KAPUAS HULU, Indonesia - Villager Octavius wades through the forest in rubber boots and tattered joggers, ears pricked, eyes peeled, a telephoto lens on his phone primed to capture orangutans, monkeys or birds.

data.title: Taylor Swift’s husband among Ponzi scheme victims
data.description: WASHINGTON - Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce, the husband of singer Taylor Swift, was among investors defrauded out of millions of dollars by a financial adviser who is going to prison.

data.title: India's transgender amendment leaves many in limbo
data.description: HYDERABAD, India - When transgender woman Kali Sidharth Medepalli began hormone replacement therapy in India, she expected to complete her medical transition and undergo surgery within a year.

data.title: Carrick takes blame as Man U suffer League Cup misery
data.description: MANCHESTER, England - Michael Carrick took the blame for Manchester United's stunning League Cup collapse against Brighton after furious fans jeered his side at Old Trafford on Wednesday.

data.title: Lula to tell Trump to ‘stay out’ of Brazil’s elections
data.description: BRASILIA - President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva said Wednesday he will tell US President Donald Trump “not to meddle in Brazil’s elections” next week during the United Nations General Assembly.

data.title: US denies Palestinian leader Abbas visa to attend UN
data.description: WASHINGTON - The United States has denied Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas an entry visa to attend the UN General Assembly in New York next week, a source familiar with the case said Wednesday.

data.title: India's transgender amendment leaves many in limbo
data.description: HYDERABAD (INDIA) - When transgender woman Kali Sidharth Medepalli began hormone replacement therapy in India, she expected to complete her medical transition and undergo surgery within a year.

data.title: 2,200 firms eyed over nominees
data.description: Authorities have identified about 2,200 companies suspected of illegally holding land through foreign-majority ownership as part of a crackdown on nominee businesses.

data.title: Carrick takes the blame as troubled Man Utd suffer League Cup misery
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Michael Carrick took the blame for Manchester United's stunning League Cup collapse against Brighton after furious fans jeered his side at Old Trafford on Wednesday.

data.title: Mbappe explains Ceuta shirt stance after criticism
data.description: BARCELONA - Real Madrid superstar Kylian Mbappe said on Wednesday that he wanted to make a gesture in support of immigrants who had lost their lives by not wearing a t-shirt in support of the people of Ceuta properly.

data.title: US Fed raises rates to tackle 'too high' inflation, irking Trump
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US Federal Reserve on Wednesday raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, defying President Donald Trump's demand for cuts, as central bank chief Kevin Warsh stressed the need to combat inflation that has been "too high" for "too long."

data.title: NFL Chiefs' Kelce among investors bilked in Ponzi scheme
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce, husband of singer Taylor Swift, was among investors defrauded out of millions of dollars by a financial adviser who is going to prison.

data.title: Trump to host Xi amid pomp, low expectations
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US military honor guard has been rehearsing and the new White House helipad is ready. But will Xi Jinping and Donald Trump achieve lift-off at their summit next week?
